owner: original Portal V2 design and engineering agent within ONE BRAIN
root_cause: The main V2 route foregrounds numerous workflow stages, long descriptions, KPIs and a large page catalog. Mobile was largely a responsive desktop layout without a compact task-first bottom navigation; the authenticated entrepreneur home repeated the next action.
customer_impact: A first-time entrepreneur cannot reliably identify what needs attention, how to act, and what is independently proven, especially on a phone. Direct user-testing evidence is still outstanding.
prevention: Present one prominently prioritized next action on the existing authenticated snapshot; show evidence and technical depth on demand; preserve full role-gated registry while giving mobile four task-oriented shortcuts. Release requires actual usability and mobile readback rather than self-assessed aesthetic claims.
actions: Place the single next-action card before extended proof, source and journey details, and expose explicit disclosure controls.
Keep first-visit goal choices immediately reachable; retain existing canonical goal save and tenant-specific server state.
Use the existing router for Today, Actions, Result, More mobile tabs; collapse the desktop group list without deleting pages.
Check accessibility, screen sizes, role authorization and provider/readback before declaring live.
closure: OPEN until exact protected PR checks succeed, a same-source Netlify deployment is independently confirmed, iOS/mobile functional and accessibility checks pass and real entrepreneurs complete the core tasks without explanation.
